findings.note: Confirms Messick starts ALCS Game 2 but says his two ALDS starts were short (4 1/3 IP, then 2 1/3 IP and 65 pitches with four walks), and Wednesday's off day gives Vogt a full, rested bullpen, which points to a short leash.

Says Messick is at 193 innings this season, far above his previous career high of 138 1/3, so fatigue is a risk; he says he feels great and his fastball velocity in his last start was above his season average.

In his July 26 start against the Rays at Tropicana Field, Messick struck out six over 7 2/3 innings with no walks and was 2-0 with a 1.03 ERA in four career starts against Tampa Bay; MLB video also shows a nine-strikeout start against them in April.
